column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in Modern Standard
# Arabic, with the terms Arabic system software uses (تثبيت, تحديث, تنزيل). The user is addressed
# directly, in the singular, as in Arabic system interfaces. Commands are verbal nouns (تثبيت,
# فتح, إلغاء التثبيت). A sentence starts with an Arabic word where it can, so it reads right to
# left even when it names a product.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# name "Craft App Suite", app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft,
# PdfCraft, EffectCraft, WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft, SoundCraft, FigCraft), "GitHub",
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc).
# Arabic is drawn with the system's Arabic font (see cjk_font.rs) and the window is mirrored;
# where the system has no Arabic font, the interface stays in English.
